# Visit Pass Catalog — The Meridian Nashville

**Generated by:** AI Planner skill
**Built:** Tuesday, September 15, 2026
**Prepared by:** Ari Navarro, with Sofia Romano (outlets) and Tomás Herrera (voice)
**Files:** `10-msg2ai-export/visit-pass/` → `hotel.json`, `experiences.json`, `restaurants.json`, `info-card.json`

> Illustrative mock. The hotel is fictional. Nearby places are named for realism, but their details here are not verified. In a real run every item passes step 4 (open now, links load) before msg2ai loads the catalog.

## hotel.json

```json
{
  "displayName": "The Meridian Nashville",
  "destination": "Nashville",
  "homeArea": "SoBro",
  "bookingUrl": "https://book.meridiannashville.com/?arrival={arrival}&departure={departure}&adults={adults}&utm_source=ai_planner",
  "whatsapp": "+16155550188",
  "contactEmail": "concierge@meridiannashville.com",
  "contactWhatsApp": "+16155550140",
  "contactUrl": "https://meridiannashville.com/contact"
}
```

`homeArea` is SoBro, so every plan keeps its half-day outings in SoBro and on Broadway, with longer trips only as day trips. The booking link is our own Bookassist engine, never an OTA.

## info-card.json

> **The Meridian — visit info.** Rideshare pick-up on the 4th Ave side; valet $48/night. Music City Center is a 6-minute walk. Emergency 911 · Front desk +1-615-555-0140. Ask us anything on WhatsApp, for the whole stay.

## What the catalog does *not* cover (contact instead)

- Event tickets, rates for specific dates, parking for oversized vehicles, pet policy exceptions.
- For these, the app says the hotel's information doesn't cover it and points to concierge@meridiannashville.com or WhatsApp +1-615-555-0140.

Ready for msg2ai to load. It goes into the hotel's app during set-up and is not uploaded with `property.json`.
